title: My Roommate Was a Time Traveler

lines.text: My roommate Ren was weird in a very organized way.
lines.caps: My roommate *Ren | was weird | in a very *organized way.

lines.text: He labeled his food with dates that haven't happened yet.
lines.caps: He labeled his food | with dates | that haven't *happened yet.

lines.text: His clock ran backwards, but only on Sundays.
lines.caps: His clock ran *backwards, | but only on *Sundays.

lines.text: He flinched every time it rained, like he'd read the script.
lines.caps: He flinched every time it *rained, | like he'd *read the script.

lines.text: One night I found our fridge full of sticky notes. All in my handwriting.
lines.caps: One night I found our fridge | full of *sticky notes. | All in *my handwriting.

lines.text: Don't take the 8:15 bus. Say yes at the pier. Buy two umbrellas.
lines.caps: 'Don't take the *8:15 bus.' | '*Say yes at the pier.' | 'Buy *two umbrellas.'

lines.text: I asked him about it. He said, 'How was the bus today?'
lines.caps: I asked him about it. | He said, | 'How was the *bus today?'

lines.text: I said, 'Fine. Why?' He said, 'No reason. Yet.'
lines.caps: I said, '*Fine. Why?' | He said, | 'No reason. *Yet.'

lines.text: On moving day, he left his watch running backwards on my table.
lines.caps: On moving day, | he left his watch | running *backwards | on my *table.

lines.text: Ten years later, at a pier, a stranger asked me to say yes.
lines.caps: Ten years *later, | at a *pier, | a stranger asked me | to say *yes.

lines.text: I did. And the spare umbrella in my bag suddenly made sense.
lines.caps: I *did. | And the *spare umbrella in my bag | suddenly made *sense.
